title: Running Commentary on Torah 36 — Bi'krov Alai Mer'eim
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 36 — בקרוב עלי מרעים
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Three-layer line-by-line gloss: beginner = readable English prose with bracketed translations; intermediate = compact bilingual summary with citations; scholarly = terse Hebrew citation list. Coarse 11-segment structure preserves Rabbeinu's own ois-marking; each segment unfolds the full content of all aligned_segments within its span. Per Reb Nosson's note (Ois י), this Torah is sod kavanos Kaddish.
